purpose: Score the development comparisons once on 2026 as a temporal and domain test. Report results regardless of direction.
rows: Same forecast-row builder as the original study, rebuilt through 2026 into a separate file. The rebuilt 2021-2025 rows must equal the saved study rows exactly before any 2026 outcome is read.
per_type: Same per-type measurement code and 400-draw outing bootstrap for 2025 and 2026; 2021-2024 reuse the saved development table. Priors fitted on 2021-2025 only.

models.P: B plus the eight per-type features, C=0.001
models.NB: Gradient-boosted trees on B features, max_iter=100, development fixed settings
models.NP: Gradient-boosted trees on P features, max_iter=100, development fixed settings

settings_rationale: C=0.001 is the frozen original setting and the value development tuning chose for B, V, C and P in both folds; max_iter=100 is what development tuning chose for every nonlinear model. No 2026 tuning.
measurement_compatibility: MLB documents 2026 plate-location and strike-zone definition changes. Primary models keep frozen feature lists. Sensitivity drops zone_rate_cur and chg_zone_rate: Pnz-Bnz and Bnz-B. Pitch labels unseen in training use the metric-pool prior.
repertoire_fallback: Original rule fitted on 2021-2025 eligible rows; unsupported 2026 forecasts use A for every compared model.
audits: league K% and BB% by season
predicted minus observed totals for every model
calibration deciles for A, B and P
scoring: Binomial log loss per batter faced; pitcher-cluster bootstrap with 1000 draws; BF-weighted directional share.
rehearsal: Before freezing, the identical code scores 2025 with 2021-2024 training as a pipeline check. 2025 was already inspected, so the rehearsal is descriptive only.
stop_rule: Freeze sources and this design before downloading 2026. Run the 2026 scoring once; it refuses to overwrite its output. Report every comparison and audit.
